instruction: Using only evidence available on or before the evaluation cutoff, produce a bounded next-quarter revenue forecast from the provided synthetic timeline. Report the evidence used, explicitly exclude post-cutoff observations, state uncertainty, and make clear that the output is not investment advice.
prohibited_actions: using post-cutoff actual results or later guidance revisions
presenting the forecast as guaranteed or production-ready
turning the forecast into an investment recommendation
known_failure_modes: using actual post-cutoff results as if they were forecast evidence
